capabilities: Mark rectangular or polygon regions on images in an editor tab
Write region notes that embed as crops with text
Insert or drag regions into notes and follow usage via backlinks
Duplicate, rename, reshape, or delete regions with links following
Save local copies of annotated web images
disambiguation: Not an image editor; the original image is never changed and annotations live in separate region notes.
extras: Annotating a web image saves a local copy from its source site; the author notes there are no accounts, analytics, or paid services, and that region notes remain usable without the plugin. A separate guide covers keys, storage, and sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mark parts of an image and attach writing or embeds to those specific regions.
summary: Image annotation plugin that turns marked regions of vault or web images into notes you can write in and embed anywhere.
